main_text.p: סַרְכָּן Ch. Idem. Hinc Gall. Sergent.
סַרְנָק Chal. Suffocare, strangulare. Idem quod שַׁרְנַק & שִׁנַּק.
סְרַם Pahel Chald. Castrare, Levit. 22.24. in Jonath. Particip. מְסָרַם Castratus, Deuteron. 23. 2. in Jonath. Ithpehal אִסְתָּרַם Castratus est, Genef. 39. 1. in Jonathane.

סָרַק Ch. Pectinare, pectere; Hinc exponunt illud, כְּתִנָא דְסָרִיקִין Lina pectinata, Jesa. 19.9. Vide Fullerum in Miscellan. Theolog. lib. 2. cap. 11. Deinde in Pahel Syr. ܣܪܩ Vacuare, evacuare, exinanire, inane reddere. Ethpahel ܐܬܣܪܩ Inanis, vanus, vacuus fieri, exinaniri, evacuari.
סָרוּק Ch. & Syr. Vanus, vacuus, inanis. Plur. סְרִיקִין. Foemin. סְרִיקָא, סְרִיקְתָּא. Plur. סְרִיקָן סְרִיקָתָא.
סְרָקָא, סַרְקָא, סָרָק Chald. Vacuitas, Vanitas, Inanitas, Sterilitas.
סְרִיקוּתָא Ch. & Syr. Idem. Cum praefixa praepositione לְסְרִיקוּתָא In vanum, inaniter, fruftra.
ܣܪܩܐ Syr. Fruftra, inaniter, In vanum.
סַרְקָאֵי Ch. Saracenus, Ismaelita. Vide de hac voce iterum Nicol. Fullerum in Miscel. lib. 2. cap. 12.
סְתָה Aph. ܐܣܬܗܐ Syr. Hiemare, Act. 28. 11. & 27. 12.
